name: llmproxy
description: Standalone GitHub Copilot proxy CLI with native service management

0.2.60: embed current release notes in the installed package for first-update compatibility
keep deriving update changelogs from the release commit message when available
preserve hardcoded release notes only as a backward-compatible final fallback
0.2.61: stabilize launchd service restart by avoiding explicit stop before kickstart on macOS
treat missing launchd bootout targets as already stopped during service recovery
cap forwarded Copilot tools to 128 on both /responses and /chat/completions
make claude:setup and model:set target the installed llmproxy service port when LLMPROXY_HOME is set
0.2.62: document detailed help pages for release-notes and all provider:* commands
cover the CLI help surface with regression tests so every public command resolves through llmproxy help <command>
keep the installed service/runtime behavior unchanged while shipping the CLI help fix
0.2.63: fix self-update when npm install -g falls back to sudo so the refreshed llmproxy binary is resolved from the correct global prefix
remove stale user-level llmproxy shims when the new install lands under the sudo-managed global prefix
cover the sudo update path with a regression test to keep llmproxy version aligned after update
0.2.64: make self-update verify which llmproxy binary actually exposes the freshly installed target version before reporting success
clean up stale llmproxy shims by comparing all resolved binaries against the version-matched target binary after update
fail the update path instead of reporting a false success when no resolved llmproxy binary matches the new installed version
